_doc: COMPAT-DATE-1 (Q-YEAR-dependency-drift): Worker compatibility dates advance by a loop, not by hand. foundation/compatdate.py moves every date in doctrine/topology.json (each worker and system_compatibility_date) and in every tracked wrangler.toml to today minus lag_days, when it is at least min_step_days behind that target. It runs on every watchdog pass inside the runway step, so the change merges and deploys through the lane, whose probe rolls a bad date back. check fails when any date is older than max_age_days, which means the loop stopped. It also reads every node-version pin in .github/workflows: a pin whose Node major leaves maintenance (node_eol, the Node.js release schedule) within node_min_days, or a major missing from the table, fails check, so the move to the next LTS starts a year ahead.
